getDigest(uint256,address).details: Call this to get the exact hash that must be signed

returns.signers: Array of addresses who have signed

signClaim(uint256,bytes).details: Caller provides an ECDSA signature over the EIP-712 typed data.      The recovered signer is recorded (allows relayed/meta-tx signing).      Optionally stake EMET by approving this contract before calling.

params.signature: 65-byte ECDSA signature (r, s, v) over the claim digest

signClaimWithStake(uint256,bytes,uint256.details: Same as signClaim but with an optional stake amount for skin-in-the-game.      If claim is rejected, co-signers lose their stake.

params.signature: 65-byte ECDSA signature (r, s, v) over the claim digest
params.stake: Amount of EMET to stake alongside the signature (0 for no stake)

withdrawStake(uint256).details: Only callable after claim is verified. Rejected claims forfeit stakes.

constructor.notice: Deploy signature contract linked to registry

getDigest(uint256,address).notice: Build the EIP-712 digest for a claim (for off-chain signing)

getSignerCount(uint256).notice: Get the number of co-signers for a claim

getSignerStake(uint256,address).notice: Get the stake a signer has on a claim

getSigners(uint256).notice: Get all co-signers for a claim

hasSigned(uint256,address).notice: Whether an address has signed a specific claim

hasWithdrawn(uint256,address).notice: Whether a signer has withdrawn their stake from a resolved claim

signClaim(uint256,bytes).notice: Co-sign an existing claim with an EIP-712 signature

signClaimWithStake(uint256,bytes,uint256.notice: Co-sign an existing claim with an EIP-712 signature and optional EMET stake

signerStake(uint256,address).notice: Stake deposited by each signer per claim

totalStake(uint256).notice: Total stake across all signers for a claim

withdrawStake(uint256).notice: Withdraw stake from a verified claim
